description: Writes a new version of an existing draft, or renames its preview address. Acts as a patch: files you send are written as a new version, files you omit carry forward unchanged, and earlier versions are kept. For when the user wants to change the copy, sections or layout of a draft that already exists, or give its preview a different readable name. Returns the version and preview_url. Cannot spend money.

host.description: A domain your account has proven it owns and attached as a draft host (POST /agency-hosts). With label, the draft is also published at https://{label}.{host}, noindex and with no Scopeweb banner. Send host and label together.

label.description: The address on host, for example ninkasi for ninkasi.example.com. 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; names that imitate login, payment or brand pages are refused.

slug.description: New readable word for the preview address; the draft keeps its random tag where it can (ninkasi-k7q becomes brewing-k7q). The previous address keeps redirecting. Send slug alone to rename without writing a new version.

name: update_draft
